changes: Remove the lifecycle's 15-minute age-based teaching-turn cancellation from both maintenance paths; no replacement silence deadline.
Keep active queued/running teaching protected after departure. Durable task completion still starts inactivity before ordinary checkpoint/release.
Keep explicit cancellation, genuine failures, shared runner worker-lease/orphan recovery, worker/attempt write fences and learning gates.
Replace the CI test's single-scan/timing assumption with an explicit archive-entry gate, real concurrent scanning/foreground assertions, and subsequent idle scans.
Fail promptly if maintenance completes/rejects before reaching the gate; await both maintenance operations before restoring test state.

ciDiagnosis.symptom: runtime.pg.test.ts concurrency test timed out waiting for its first archive; no export started even with the five-second wait.
ciDiagnosis.localReproduction: The unmodified test failed locally on the first isolated invocation.
ciDiagnosis.cause: A lightweight recent-study renewal can win the sole maintenance admission slot. Both archive attempts defer and the only scan completes. Waiting does not schedule another scan.
ciDiagnosis.fix: Arrange an actual blocked archive before testing concurrent scanning/foreground capacity. Preserve deferred renewal, exactly-one-archive, foreground activity/checkpoint and later reclamation assertions.

teachingPolicyValidation.preFix: New healthy queued/reasoning/tool-state regressions failed on the age cancellation policy.
postFix: Healthy queued and running reasoning/tool states older than fifteen minutes remain uncancelled, without changing teaching revision.
An aged active turn remains protected after learner departure; completion starts a fresh inactivity interval.
A stale worker lease is reclaimed through the shared claim interface; old heartbeat and terminal writes are fenced.
A recovered task completes, then its genuinely idle study checkpoints and releases.
teachingPolicyValidation.timeModel: Aged durable PostgreSQL timestamps and controlled command reservations; not twenty minutes of live model/tool execution.

companion.limitation: The companion remains a separate open PR. Existing runner-level limits remain on this branch until #2003 is integrated; no merged runtime or live end-to-end joint acceptance is claimed.
